scope: Local rules and official emulator; production configuration unverified
summary: Default deny, UID authority, bounded queries and nested validation on create/update. Daily history replaces legacy opaque writes; permanent deletion and masking are enforced server-side.

findings.issue: Live rules, IAM, App Check and existing user-data migration have not been verified.
findings.recommendation: Stage migration, compare exports and verify deployed rules before stable release.

checks.authority: request.auth.uid == userId; no client role claims
checks.create_update: Same validators, allowed keys and bounded nested types
checks.history: Schema 3 daily calendar-valid documents; legacy map writes denied
checks.business: Permanent tombstone and masking policy checks
checks.resource_limits: Bounded list queries, payload bounds and batches respecting rule-access budget
